Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: A minimum data exchange cloud platform was built for business data (owner, physical address, tax ID, date of creation). E-Services Gateway includes business licensing and import/export permits. Registrar General's Office is being digitalized. EODB Portal under development (NRD Companies, targeting June 2026) will consolidate business services. Partially functional for business data but not a full exchange system.

Comments: The Registrar General's Office handles civil registration and is undergoing digitalization (President Ramkalawan visited February 2025). Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Seychelles has a comprehensive national identity database with cards widely used by citizens. The e-Services Gateway stores individual and business e-IDs for credential verification. However, there is no end-to-end digital ID integration with a central data exchange platform. World Bank Digital Government report (2020) recommends developing digital identity services as a priority. No fully integrated digital ID-exchange platform documented.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: No specific implementation roadmap for a national data exchange or interoperability platform found. The EODB Portal has a 9-month project timeline targeting June 2026 but this is a single portal not a government-wide data exchange system. OGP Action Plan has general digital transformation milestones but not a data exchange roadmap.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Under the overarching Vision 2033 framework, Seychelles has a DICT Institutional Strategic Plan (2018-2022) listing policy actions including intra-government connectivity. A National ICT Policy (NICTP) exists via the National ICT Consultative Committee. Interoperability and data exchange are mentioned within broader ICT/digital government frameworks but there is no comprehensive dedicated data exchange strategy. Ranked 92nd on 2024 UN EGDI (score 0.6773).

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Seychelles has an e-Services Gateway and SeyGo Connect portal, but no unified data exchange platform. Multiple digital government initiatives show 'little evidence of talking to each other and sharing data' (APRI 2024). A 'minimum data exchange' cloud platform was built for business registration data sharing. The Registrar General's Office is being digitalized. An Ease of Doing Business Portal is planned (NRD Companies, launch June 2026). No interoperability platform comparable to a national data exchange hub is operational.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: OGP Action Plan 2023-2025 explicitly commits to increasing IT literacy including for elderly and ensuring no one is 'left behind' in digital engagement. Seychelles has a high human capital index (0.78 in 2022 EGDI). Telecommunications infrastructure is the best in Africa (TII score 0.82 in 2022). However, the OGP also notes that e-engagement portal commitment 'has not begun'. Accessibility improvements are in progress but not fully achieved.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Seychelles is a small island state (population ~98,000) with no subnational (provincial/state) government layer. The country has 26 administrative districts but no separate sub-national tier. All digital government services operate at national level.
